bibl.title: Devotees of Serapis and Christ? A Literary Representation of Religious Cohabitations in the 4th Cent.
bibl.seg: Francesco Massa, Devotees of Serapis and Christ? A Literary Representation of Religious Cohabitations in the 4th Cent.

Luca Arcari (ed.), Beyond Conflicts. Cultural and Religious Cohabitations in Alexandria and Egypt between the 1st and the 6th Century CE = Studien und Texte zu Antike und Christentum. 103 (Tübingen, 2017) pp. 263-281.
bibl.note: On the overlap between Serapis and Christ, primarily based on the Vita Saturni in the Historia Augusta. - 1. Endgame? The destruction of the Serapeum. - 2. Why Serapis and the Christians? - 3. Qui Serapim colunt Christiani sunt… - 4. Serapis and Christ: new gods. - 5. And if Serapis was none other than Joseph? - 6. Shared spaces, stolen spaces. - 7. Return to the destruction of the Serapeum, and conclusion.
